About this Extension

This extension combines Google Lens features (interactive area snipping, OCR text extraction, image copying, video frame capture) with your Browser's Default Search Engine (such as Brave Search, DuckDuckGo, Bing, or Startpage) opening searches in a fresh new tab.

  • 🔍 Default Search Engine: Never forces Google; respects your browser's configured search provider in a new tab.
  • 📝 Direct Text Copy: Copies webpage text or extracted OCR text straight to your clipboard.
  • 🖼️ Direct Image Copy: Copies cropped PNG image screenshots straight to your clipboard.
  • 🔒 Zero Tracking: No external proxies or tracking servers.
